  requires (bal >= 0)
  requires (x != 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((result == (bal + x)) or (result == bal))
  ensures ((not (x > 0)) or (result == (bal + x)))
  ensures (((bal + x) >= 0) or (result == bal))
  effects pure
  example (apply(0, 10) == 10)
  example (apply(10, -3) == 7)
  example (apply(5, -20) == 5)
  example (apply(0, -5) == 0)
{
  if (x > 0) then (bal + x) else if ((bal + x) >= 0) then (bal + x) else bal
}

fn run(xs: List[Int], bal: Int) -> Int
  requires (bal >= 0)
  requires forall x in xs: (x != 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result >= (bal + (sum x in xs: x)))
  ensures (result <= (bal + (sum x in xs: if (x > 0) then x else 0)))
  effects pure
  example (run([], 5) == 5)
  example (run([10, -3, -20, 5], 0) == 12)
  example (run([-5, 2], 0) == 2)
{
  match xs { [] => bal [h, ..t] => run(t, apply(bal, h)) }
}

fn balance(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires forall x in xs: (x != 0)

  example (balance([10, -3, -20, 5]) == 12)
  example (balance([-5, 2]) == 2)
  example (balance([]) == 0)
{
  run(xs, 0)

fn interleave(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) + len(ys)))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): ((result[(2 * i)] == xs[i]) and (result[((2 * i) + 1)] == ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (interleave([1, 2, 3], [7, 8, 9]) == [1, 7, 2, 8, 3, 9])
  example (interleave([], []) == [])
  example (interleave([5], [6]) == [5, 6])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => [] [g, ..u] => ([h, g] ++ interleave(t, u)) } }
}

{

fn scan(xs: List[Int], cur: Int, best: Int) -> Int
  requires (cur <= best)
  ensures (result >= best)
  ensures (result >= cur)
  effects pure
  example (scan([], 3, 3) == 3)
  example (scan([-2], 2, 2) == 2)
  example (scan([-1, 5, -2], -1, -1) == 5)
{
  match xs { [] => best [h, ..t] => scan(t, if (cur > 0) then (cur + h) else h, if (best >= (if (cur > 0) then (cur + h) else h)) then best else if (cur > 0) then (cur + h) else h) }
}

fn max_subarray(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires exists x in xs: (x > 0)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): forall k in (i + 1)..(len(xs) + 1): (result >= (sum j in i..k: xs[j]))
  ensures exists i in 0..len(xs): exists k in (i + 1)..(len(xs) + 1): (result == (sum j in i..k: xs[j]))
  effects pure
  example (max_subarray([1, -2, 3, 4, -1]) == 7)
  example (max_subarray([2, 2, -5, 1]) == 4)
  example (max_subarray([-1, 5, -2]) == 5)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => scan(t, h, h) }
}

  requires sorted(xs)
  requires sorted(ys)
  requires forall x in xs: not contains(ys, x)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) + len(ys)))

  ensures forall x in xs: (count(result, x) == (count(xs, x) + count(ys, x)))
  ensures forall y in ys: (count(result, y) == (count(xs, y) + count(ys, y)))
  effects pure
  example (merge_sorted([1, 4, 9], [2, 3]) == [1, 2, 3, 4, 9])
  example (merge_sorted([], [5, 6]) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([2], []) == [2])
  example (merge_sorted([], []) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => ys [a, ..s] => match ys { [] => xs [b, ..t] => if (a < b) then ([a] ++ merge_sorted(s, ys)) else ([b] ++ merge_sorted(xs, t)) } }
}

  requires contains(xs, best)
  requires (best_n == count(xs, best))
  requires forall x in cands: contains(xs, x)
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall x in xs: (count(xs, x) <= count(xs, result))
  effects pure

  example (scan([5, 5, 1], [5, 5, 1], 5, 2) == 5)
{
  match cands { [] => best [h, ..t] => if (tally(xs, h) > best_n) then scan(t, xs, h, tally(xs, h)) else scan(t, xs, best, best_n) }

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)

{

}

fn take_while_pos(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) <= len(xs))
  ensures forall x in result: (x > 0)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[i])
  ensures ((len(result) == len(xs)) or (not (xs[len(result)] > 0)))
  effects pure

  example (take_while_pos([0, 4]) == [])
  example (take_while_pos([]) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h > 0) then ([h] ++ take_while_pos(t)) else [] }
}
